steps.content: Behind Lichen, the black mist thickens and knots with the votive force, churning like the breath of something colossal stirring awake.
She faces you, her tone like frost.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Go back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: And if I don't?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: What then? You'll use your power, your monster, to kill me too?
She doesn't seem angry. Her face now looks nearly identical to the phantoms you've seen in this world: pale, stiff, incapable of forming any expression.
The "god" at her back rises again. Lichen regards you with cold detachment. The hidden meanings beneath her words and glances are lost to you now. Perhaps they always were.
Maybe she's ready to crush the obstacle standing before her, just as she once cut down those phantoms for your sake. To her, both are equally effortless.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Do whatever you want to me.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: But I'm not leaving, not until I get you out of here.
The space resounds with furious roars, as if answering your refusal to yield.

The sheer force of it blurs your sight. Lichen's silhouette melts into the black mist. You draw a slow breath and tighten your fist. Red sparks glimmer in your palm, fragile as candle flames in the thick fog pressing in on all sides.
But you will not turn back. Not here.

steps.speaker: Apostle of Ashes
steps.content: <color=#dg1f1f><i><b>AAAAAAH!
The monster raises its hand, blade held high. Lichen's form follows in perfect sync, as if pulled by the same strings.
[Red Flash + Special Effect]
The executioner's blade meant to end you falls, but its edge meets Lichen's shoulder instead. A shudder runs through her body, and the ribbons binding her cinch deeper.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: Silence...!
The monster jerks sharply in rhythm with the bell at her hip, then, impossibly, falls still. But under its fluttering robe, the black muck keeps writhing, waiting for the next chance to strike.

steps.speaker: Lichen
steps.content: ...Go back.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You really can't control it yet, can you?
She stands, her shoulders still trembling. She doesn't turn your way.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Lichen...
You walk toward her. The nearer you draw, the more savagely the Mania surges, eating away at your mind and dulling your senses.
Your resistance is nearly spent. If she chose to act now, you'd have no strength left to defend.
She could do it again, just like before: hoist you up, wrap her hands around your throat, and crush your bones.
But her hands are no longer pale. She wouldn't even need force. A flick of her fingers, and those beast-like claws would pierce your throat without effort, opening the path for the horror behind her.
(Transition 2s)
But when you stand close enough to touch, she does nothing.
You rest your hands lightly against her waist. Under your palms, Mania churns.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've always wanted me to tell you everything I know, haven't you?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: You've always wanted to borrow the power of my shackles, right?

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Then see for yourself.
You release your shackles, and <color=#fb9259>memories</color> unfurl before you.
